documents.title: Munafa product guide
documents.text: An accepted supplier invoice does not increase stock. Record physical quantities separately and review units. Accepting receiving adds undamaged goods. A partial delivery is not a final shortage. Missing physical quantities require merchant entry.

documents.title: Munafa product guide
documents.text: A supplier promise is not recovered money. Resolve only with matching supplier/invoice/amount, unique reference/document evidence and explicit confirmation that the credit was applied or refund received. Approved snapshots and financial history remain immutable.

documents.title: Munafa product guide
documents.text: After connected installation/cache warm-up the app shell can launch offline. Device drafts remain pending until the server accepts them. AI and connected APIs require internet. A conflict needs human review; retry does not overwrite accepted history. Unsynced data may be lost if browser storage is cleared or evicted.

documents.title: Paytm Settlement Detail API — technical documentation
documents.text: The public technical documentation describes settlement fields including commission, GST and dates, and states this API is not hosted on staging. Munafa has no authorised live connection. A recorded payout difference needs component/source review and does not establish missing money. This excerpt is technical context, not a fee or refund policy.
